usage: 一個鐘usually refers to a duration of exactly one hour.
It can be used to indicate how long an activity lasts.
In casual conversations, people say they need "一個鐘" to do something, meaning an hour is required.
It can be combined with verbs like 去 (go), 做 (do), or 等 (wait) to describe time spent.
